description: Current comparison across institutions for a product category (home_loan | savings | term_deposit | credit_card | personal_loan | car_loan | business_loan): each product at its own most recent observation (observedDate tells you how fresh). Home loans can be filtered by loanPurpose/repaymentType/rateType — the headline home-loan rate is the owner-occupied P&I rate whose LVR band covers 80%. Term deposits take termMonths (the published rate for that term, e.g. 6 or 12) and deposits take customerSegment. Standard products only unless audience says otherwise. Returns the best `limit` rows (default 25, at most 40); `truncated` says more exist. It has no lender filter: for one lender's products use find_products. Fees are summarised (name, type, amount or rate, frequency); rate_details has every fee field.

asOf.description: Historical snapshot date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to each product's latest observation.

audience.description: Who the product is for. Default standard (untagged rows count as standard); "any" includes green, veteran, SMSF, construction and other special-purpose products.

customerSegment.description: savings and term_deposit only: personal or business products.

limit.description: Rows to return, best first. Default 25, at most 40.

termMonths.description: term_deposit only: rank each product's published rate for this term in months (6, 12, 24 …).

name: compare_rates
